text:
emma: sunday reset idea 1 1 pick one album and one single tv episode to pair. low commitment, big vibe. whos in? :sun_with_face: :tv:
rafi: in. Album: Beach House  'Bloom' (dreamy). Episode: 'San Junipero' (Black Mirror)  short, nostalgic, pairs nicely.
meera: love that. my pair: Sufjan Stevens  'Carrie & Lowell' and the 'Chef's Table' episode on pastry (so soothing and oddly food-soothing).
tom: ok quirky pick: Godspeed You! Black Emperor  'Lift Your Skinny Fists' (long, cinematic) + 'Halt and Catch Fire' S1E1 (tech nostalgia). maybe too heavy though.
june: i vote light: 'Kiasmos' instrumental album + 'Parks and Rec' Leslie Knope episode (S3E2?). perfect for unwinding and still smiling. :laughing:
poll-bot: Poll created: Which pair should win the Sunday micro-marathon? Options: 1) Bloom + San Junipero, 2) Carrie & Lowell + Chef's Table, 3) Kiasmos + Parks and Rec. React with 1,2,3 to vote.
emma: reacting with :one: (for nostalgia).
rafi: :one:
meera: :two: (pastry > code today)
tom: :three: but retroactively agree it's a heavy vibe.
june: :three: (team cozy)
poll-bot: Poll closed. Results: 1) 2 votes, 2) 1 vote, 3) 2 votes. Tie between 1 and 3.
emma: tie-breaker rule: album length under 50 minutes wins the day  so that means Kiasmos wins. august sunday ritual incoming. :confetti_ball:
rafi: playlist link if anyone wants: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example-kiasmos-parks (curated low-dynamics mix).
meera: will bring croissants and a tiny notebook for thoughts. highly optional but delightful. :croissant: :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
